description: Clips used to re-measure the detectors with tools/measure_clips.py. Paths are relative to backend/. These are phone-style H.264/AAC files (one is video-only), not browser recordings, so results are a smoke check, not a calibration. Labels come from the file names and from what each clip shows; nothing here has been measured on attack recordings yet. A clip with "mirrored": true was saved as a mirror image (the person's own left is the left of the picture, as a selfie app shows it); the tool flips it back to what a browser records before analysing, because the backend expects an unmirrored feed. Browser recordings need no flag.
